text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — sudden spike in 5xx + tail latency on hosted /v1/generate (region: eu-west1). Severity: P2. Paging oncall now. Metrics: https://metrics.redwood.internal/d/requests?panel=kv_evictions

SRE Rotation: ack. Theo S on pager. Theo S: jumping in, pulling runtime logs and recent deploys.

Theo S: initial look — major uptick in KV cache eviction events on runtime pool infer-eu-1a starting ~1825567600. We see repeated model fallback to variant r2-high and sporadic OOMs from worker processes.

Deploy Bot: Deploy completed by Eng-ML @ 1825567400 — model-variant q4-low (quantized) rolled to 20% in eu-west1.

Priya N: CS alert — customers nimbus and ember report increased latency and some failed requests. Notifying account contacts.

Theo S: hypothesis: q4-low reduced per-model memory footprint but has a different KV cache access pattern leading to non-uniform shard pressure. Combined with aggressive concurrent-batching window change from autoscaler tweak yesterday, this caused thrashing of KV segments and transient mem spikes.

Luis M: on routing/scale — autoscaler had a tuned mem_threshold at 72% (recent change). When eviction churn hit, processes temporarily hit >90% leading to fallbacks. Rolling back the mem_threshold to 80% now and pausing the q4-low rollout.

Theo S: mitigation steps taken (live):
- paused q4-low rollout in eu-west1 (Deploy Bot: rollback queued)
- raised mem_threshold to 80% for infer-eu-1a
- added emergency circuit-breaker to throttle top 2 heavy tenants (nimbus, ember) to limit concurrency
- forced model fallback pin to r2-small for 15m to reduce OOMs

Priya N: ACCT ops pinged customers; they asked for ETA and postmortem.

~8 minutes later~
incident-bot: 5xxs and p95 latency returned to baseline. No new OOMs observed for 10m.

Theo S: live mitigation stabilized. Will keep throttles for 30m while we validate.

Priya N: suggest postmortem owner: Sarah C (platform reliability PM). Proposed meeting window: in 36 hours to capture deploy info and repro artifacts.

Sarah C: I can own postmortem. I'll create the doc and calendar. Please create tickets for action items and size them.

Theo S: creating initial action items now:
- INC-2101: Backfill regression test for KV access pattern with q4-low (owner: Eng-ML + Theo S) — estimate: 4d — severity: high — reason: prevent divergent access patterns on new quantized variants.
- INC-2102: Autoscaler safety rollback + integration test (owner: Luis M) — estimate: 3d — severity: high — reason: autoscaler mem_threshold tuning caused cascading evictions.
- INC-2103: Runtime KV telemetry expand (owner: Priya N / Observability) — estimate: 2d — severity: medium — reason: better shard-level eviction metrics and alerting.
- INC-2104: Account ops automation: include impacted-tenant list in incident bot notifications (owner: Priya N) — estimate: 1d — severity: low — Q3 tie-in: improved customer comms.
- INC-2105: Canary rollout policy addendum for quantized variants (owner: Eng-ML) — estimate: 5d — severity: high — tie-in Q4 Optimize roadmap.

Luis M: I'll make INC-2102 P0 for the current sprint; INC-2101 and INC-2105 should be P0 in reliability/eng-ml sync. INC-2103/2104 P1 next sprint.

Theo S: added short-term fix ticket INC-2106: emergency throttle automation for heavy tenants (owner: Theo S) — estimate: 1d — severity: medium.

Sarah C: for the postmortem meeting please bring:
- deploy diffs + canary rollout config (Eng-ML)
- runtime mem + KV evictions timeline (Theo)
- autoscaler change diff and rationale (Luis)
- customer impact notes and comms drafts (Priya)
- proposed mitigations + draft MRs (owners)

Deploy Bot: rollback of q4-low complete in eu-west1 @ 1825568030. Canary paused globally.

Priya N: I've notified nimbus and ember that we've mitigated and scheduled a follow-up comms after the postmortem. They requested a postmortem link and ETA on fixes.

Sarah C: scheduling postmortem: Fri 09:30am CET (36h). Meeting link + doc incoming. Please create and link Jira tickets by EOD tomorrow. If anyone needs more time, call it out now.

Theo S: filing INC-2101 + INC-2106 now with repro steps and initial test harness notes.

Luis M: INC-2102 created and marked as 5 dev-days (3 dev + 2 testing/rollout). I'll attach rollout rollback playbook.

Priya N: INC-2103/2104 tickets created. I'll add acceptance criteria for alerts and account notifications.

Sarah C: prioritization decision: treat INC-2102 and INC-2105 as sprint-top reliability priorities. INC-2101 needed but coordinated with Eng-ML roadmap. INC-2103/2106 to be scheduled within next two sprints. Q4 tie-in noted for canary policy work.

SRE Rotation: live-handoff complete. Please update this channel when tickets are in the quarterly reliability board. :thumbsup:

Theo S: thanks. I'll post a short timeline in the doc and include stack traces + heap profiles.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated and closed. Summary: KV eviction thrash triggered by q4-low access pattern + recent autoscaler mem_threshold change -> model fallback and OOMs -> transient 5xx for tenants nimbus/ember. Postmortem scheduled.

---
Summary (for ticket):
- Impact: transient elevated 5xx and tail latency for /v1/generate in eu-west1 affecting nimbus and ember.
- Severity: P2.
- Immediate mitigations: pause q4-low canary, raise mem_threshold, emergency per-tenant throttle, rollback to r2-small for stability.
- Action items: INC-2101..INC-2106 (owners: Theo S, Luis M, Eng-ML, Priya N, Sarah C) with estimates and priorities.
- Next steps: postmortem Fri 09:30am CET; owners to create Jira tickets by EOD tomorrow.
